title: Evaluating Accuracy and Probabilistic Reliability of Zero-Shot Time Series Foundation Models (arXiv abstract)
note: v1 only, 22 Sep 2026, cs.LG; accepted at ADBIS 2026. Six zero-shot foundation models on energy, traffic and finance data against statistical baselines and one supervised model. Says the foundation models win on accuracy but trade accuracy against calibration; xLSTM-based models calibrate most robustly, patch transformers lose calibration at long horizons; context saturates.

title: Same paper, HTML full text: setup
note: Chronos-2, TiRex (35M), Moirai-2.0, Sundial, Toto, TimesFM (200M) at HF defaults, no revisions. Baselines: fixed-order ARIMA, running average, random walk with drift, small PatchTST. All univariate. Rolling windows of C+2H sliding by H; window count not given. Metrics: sMAPE, 80% interval coverage error (ICE), IMAE. No intervals or repeats. T4 GPU. No pre-registration mentioned.

title: Same paper, HTML full text: MixGridPL (Polish national load) setup
note: 12,407 hourly points of Polish national load over 17 months in 2024-25; exact dates not given. Fixed context C=240 with H in 12, 24, 72, 144, 288, 576, 672 (168 is not tested); fixed H=24 with C from 96 to 600. Authors say the data is recent and outside known pretraining corpora.

title: Same paper, HTML full text: MixGridPL results
note: H=12: Chronos-2, TiRex, Sundial sMAPE 3.92-3.95% vs ARIMA about 14%. H=672: Chronos-2 6.4%, Moirai-2.0 6.6%, ARIMA 19%. TiRex ICE 0.01-0.04 across scenarios. Chronos-2 at H=24: ICE 0.17 falling to 0.04 as context grows. Read by a summarising fetch, not checked against the PDF.

title: Same paper, HTML full text: other datasets and conclusion
note: Traffic (1 s counts) at H=1800: Chronos-2 sMAPE 28% vs ARIMA over 65%; ICE TimesFM 0.73, Moirai 0.56, Chronos-2 and TiRex under 0.06. SPY daily at H=252: TiRex 8.34%, Chronos-2 8.64%, ARIMA 9.68%. Conclusion: TiRex is the most consistent calibrator across data types, Chronos-2 the most balanced. Links github.com/unic-ailab/TSFM-Eval.

title: unic-ailab/TSFM-Eval (repository)
